title: How to Reserve a Spot for an Event
content:
If a user asks how to reserve an event:

- Guide them to the CultPass app
- Instruct them to browse the experience catalog and tap 'Reserve'
- If it's a premium or limited event, check if reservation confirmation is required via email
- Remind them to arrive at least 15 minutes early with their QR code visible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can reserve an experience by opening the CultPass app, selecting your desired event, and tapping 'Reserve'. Be sure to arrive 15 minutes early with your QR code ready."

title: What's Included in a CultPass Subscription
content:
Each user is entitled to 4 cultural experiences per month, which may include:
- Art exhibitions
- Museum entries
- Music concerts
- Film screenings and more

Some premium experiences may require an additional fee (visible in the app).

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your CultPass subscription includes 4 curated experiences each month. You can choose from museums, concerts, film events and more. Premium events may have an extra cost, which is shown during reservation."

title: How to Cancel or Pause a Subscription
content:
Users can manage their subscription via the app > 'My Account' > 'Manage Plan'.

- Cancel: Effective at the end of the billing cycle
- Pause: Preserves user data, resumes automatically when reactivated
- Do NOT offer refunds unless approved by support lead

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can cancel or pause your subscription at any time via the 'My Account' section in the CultPass app. Cancelation takes effect at the end of your billing cycle."

title: How to Handle Login Issues?
content:
Most login issues are resolved with password reset:

- Ask the user to tap 'Forgot Password' on the login screen
- Ensure they are using the correct registered email
- If they did not receive the reset email, check spam folder or retry after 10 minutes
- For persistent login issues, escalate to human support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Try tapping 'Forgot Password' on the login screen. Make sure you're using the email associated with your account. If the email doesn't arrive, check spam or try again in a few minutes."

title: How to View Upcoming Reservations
content:
Users can see all upcoming bookings in the CultPass app under 'My Plans' or 'Reservations'.

- Show event date, time, and venue
- QR code becomes available before the event
- Encourage users to review event instructions in advance

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can view your upcoming reservations anytime in the CultPass app under 'My Plans'. There you'll find your event details and QR code when it's available."
tags: reservations, bookings, upcoming events, qr code

title: What to Do If a Reservation Is Full
content:
If an experience is fully booked:

- Let the user know spots are limited and may open if someone cancels
- Suggest checking similar events in the app
- If a waitlist feature exists, guide them to join it

**Suggested phrasing:**
"That experience is currently full. You can check back later in case a spot opens up, or browse similar events in the app."

title: How to Cancel an Event Reservation
content:
Users can cancel a reservation from the CultPass app by opening the booked event and selecting 'Cancel Reservation'.

- Remind them to cancel as early as possible
- Mention any cancellation window if applicable
- Explain that repeated no-shows may affect future bookings if your policy supports that

**Suggested phrasing:**
"To cancel a reservation, open the event in the CultPass app and tap 'Cancel Reservation'. Please cancel as early as possible so others can book the spot."

title: What Happens If I Miss an Event
content:
If a user misses a reserved event:

- Explain whether the reservation is forfeited
- Mention any no-show policy if one exists
- Encourage canceling in advance next time when possible

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If you miss a reserved event, that booking may be forfeited. If your plans change, it's best to cancel in advance whenever possible."
tags: missed event, no-show, reservation policy, attendance

title: How to Access My QR Code
content:
Users can access their event QR code from the reservation details page in the CultPass app.

- QR code may appear only shortly before the event
- Ask users to increase screen brightness for easier scanning
- Recommend taking a screenshot if internet access at the venue may be limited

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your QR code will be available in your reservation details in the CultPass app. For easy check-in, keep your screen bright and have the code ready on arrival."
tags: qr code, check-in, reservation, event access

title: How to Update My Email Address
content:
Users can update their email from the app settings or account profile section if self-service is enabled.

- Confirm they should use an active email they can access
- If the app does not allow edits, direct them to support
- Remind them that login and notifications may be affected until updated

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can update your email in the account settings section of the CultPass app. If that option isn't available, please contact support for help."
tags: email update, account settings, profile, login

title: How to Change My Password
content:
Users can change their password from the app's security or account settings.

- If they forgot it, direct them to 'Forgot Password' from the login screen
- Encourage using a strong unique password
- Mention that they may need to log in again on other devices

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can change your password from your account settings in the CultPass app. If you've forgotten it, use the 'Forgot Password' option on the login screen."

title: How Billing Dates Work
content:
A user's billing date is typically based on the day they started their subscription.

- Renewals happen automatically unless canceled or paused
- Benefits refresh according to the billing cycle
- Premium add-ons, if any, may be charged separately

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your subscription renews automatically based on your original billing date. Monthly benefits refresh with each new billing cycle."

title: What Payment Methods Are Accepted
content:
CultPass may accept major credit cards, debit cards, and supported digital payment methods depending on region.

- Users can check available methods during checkout or in billing settings
- If a payment fails, ask them to verify card details and available funds
- For repeated failures, suggest contacting their bank or support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can view accepted payment methods during checkout or in your billing settings. If a payment doesn't go through, please verify your details and try again."
tags: payment methods, billing, checkout, card issues

title: How to Contact Support
content:
If a user needs more help:

- Direct them to the in-app help or support section
- Offer email or chat support channels if available
- Escalate account-specific or unresolved technical issues to a human agent

**Suggested phrasing:**
"If you still need help, please use the support section in the CultPass app to contact our team. We'll be happy to assist you further."

title: How to Check Experience Availability
content:
Users can check live availability directly in the CultPass app on each experience page.

- Availability may change quickly for popular events
- Encourage users to reserve early when spots are limited
- If unavailable, suggest exploring similar experiences

**Suggested phrasing:**
"You can check availability on the experience page in the CultPass app. If spots are limited, it's best to reserve early."

title: Can I Transfer My Reservation to Someone Else
content:
Reservations are generally tied to the account holder and may not be transferable unless explicitly stated.

- Ask users to review the event terms in the app
- If transfers are not supported, advise canceling the reservation if they cannot attend
- Escalate special cases only if policy allows exceptions

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Reservations are usually linked to your account and may not be transferable. Please check the event terms in the app for any exceptions."
tags: transfer reservation, booking policy, attendance, account

title: Why Is My QR Code Not Showing Yet
content:
A QR code may only appear shortly before the event start time.

- Ask the user to refresh the reservation page
- Confirm the reservation is active and not canceled
- If the event is near and the QR code still does not appear, direct them to support

**Suggested phrasing:**
"Your QR code may appear closer to the event time. Please refresh the reservation page and confirm your booking is still active."
tags: qr code, reservation, event access, troubleshooting
